apply_optimizer_in_backward: apply an optimizer to fire after backward pass on specified model parameters
get_in_backward_optimizers: retrieve a list of in-backward optimizers applied to a module's parameters
register_optimizer_hook: register an autograd hook that runs optimizer.step() after gradient accumulation
attach_multiple_optimizers: attach multiple optimizers with different hyperparameters to different parameter groups
track_optimizer_hooks: track optimizer hook handles in a weak tensor-key dictionary for cleanup and checkpointing
